title: The River - Vanilla Cream
htmlContent:
The River’s music has lately taken the music world by storm. The River conveys all the noughties and vibes in her latest single, “Vanilla Cream.” Percolating a captivating R&B sound and showing off his smoky vocals, her supernatural harmonies continue to build throughout the song while dropping synths encompasses the listener.

“Vanilla Cream” grabs you immediately with a sound full of magic and danceable ruts; intoxicating tones will take you unaware and keep you coming back for more. The track is an anxiety-free sound that lets you leave your problems at the door because of its undoubted quality. The River takes us on a trip we will never forget.

The River “Vanilla Cream” is available on all streaming platforms!
